mutation_policy.must_fail_rule: each entry names the gate that has to report the failure; an unnamed failure elsewhere does not count
mutation_policy.must_survive_rule: a battery in which every mutation fails is testing its plumbing, not the certificate
mutation_policy.separation_rule: an entry may pin the pair (unconditional_k0_theorem, e_conditional_ratio_theorem) it must report; the battery refuses unless at least one entry reports (true,false) and at least one reports (true,true)
mutation_policy.census_rule: deleting a gate is a FAIL, caught by the layer-restricted census gates and again by the runner's comparison against the sealed census hash

emission_policy.forbidden: any product decomposition, any component list other than the single literal factor K0, any nontrivial primitive idempotent, any component count other than 1
emission_policy.enforced_by: runner_r2._forbidden_language_scan and runner_r2._component_policy over every emitted artifact

aws_route.gp_binary_pin: coordinator-supplied path and SHA-256, verified by runner_r2 against the on-disk binary; execution_pins_r2.json additionally records the binary hash observed on the R1 rehearsal host for reporting only
aws_route.artifact_mode: 0444 after fsync; created with O_CREAT|O_EXCL on the final name, never overwritten and never staged through a temporary sidecar
aws_route.launch_lease: two exclusive leases, both taken before any try block: an authorization lease named after the record digest in the run parent, then an atomic mkdir of the run path. A used authorization can never be presented again, even with a fresh run path.
aws_route.local_execution_mode: none; absent a live IMDSv2 identity the supervisor exits without running any mathematics
aws_route.isolated_interpreter: python3 -I -B is retained and is now a checked property: runner_r2 refuses to run outside isolated mode and loads its sealed siblings by manifest-verified path, never through sys.path
